newsitem.title: USA: Presley sees Q1 hurt by slow Q4 orders.
newsitem.headline: Presley sees Q1 hurt by slow Q4 orders.

text.p: Presley Co said Wednesday its first quarter results will be hurt by a reduced number of new home orders in the 1996 fourth quarter and the resulting decreased backlog at the end of 1996.
It said an increase in the percentage of closings from its older, weak-performing, master-planned communities will also weigh on first quarter results.

"While I am encouraged by the rate of new home orders in recent weeks, most of these new orders will not result in closings until the second quarter and beyond," Wade Cable, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
